messages:
eva: heads-up — seeing a clear p95 delta between us-west and eu-west since the edge-proxy change ~09:10UTC. p50 stable, p95 jumped ~45ms on eu-west for our small-chat benchmark.

josh: ugh. which benchmark id? can you paste the perf-run link & config?

eva: perf-run id perf-20260320-09:08, link: https://bench.redwood/perf/20260320/perf-20260320-09:08 (internal). config: model=gpt-medium-quant, batch=4, seq=512, kernel=fast-attn-v2, kv_cache=enabled, route=egress-v2 -> edge-proxy-usw/euw.

luca: did we change TLS termination or any proxy egress rules recently? those can add hop + tail.

eva: deploy-bot: deploy edge-proxy v2 rolled at 09:05UTC to canary (10% traffic) then 09:09 ramped to 50%. saw the bump after 09:10.

deploy-bot: edge-proxy/v2 deployed: canary start 2026-03-20T09:05Z, rollout 50% 2026-03-20T09:09Z.

maria: can we run a targeted microbench from eu-west to model host (skip proxy) to isolate? run this from loadbox:

```bash
./microbench --target-model gpt-medium-quant --seq 512 --batch 4 --rps 50 --warmup 120 --direction eu-west -> host-eu-1
```

maria: and run same with proxy egress enabled: add `--via-proxy=edge-proxy-eu` to compare.

josh: also capture tcpdump at egress on both proxy and model host, and include seq-level latency histogram. small script: 

```bash
ssh loadbox-eu sudo tcpdump -i eth0 -w /tmp/proxy-egress.pcap && curl -sS http://metrics.local/perf/histogram?run=perf-20260320-09:08
```

luca: my quick theory: kernel selection (fast-attn-v2) warms differently when proxy introduces additional small MTU fragments and causes fallback path in NIC offload. i want to compare fast-attn-v2 vs fast-attn-v1 and soft-attn on same perf-run.

eva: i ran a short compare: fast-attn-v1 p95 eu-west = +12ms vs us-west, fast-attn-v2 p95 eu-west = +47ms. soft-attn p95 = +50ms so v2 is closer to soft but v1 is better. weird.

josh: that suggests proxy changes are exposing a path-sensitive fallback. could be TLS record size or packet pacing. did we change proxy MTU or enable TLS session resumption differently?

sre-oncall: noticing +10% retries from eu-west to model host during 09:10-09:20 window. relevant for tail.

maria: quick mitigation: add egress route rule to prefer direct-host where tenant latency sensitive, or temporarily roll proxy back for 10% traffic to validate rollback impact. canary rollback is quick.

luca: for sizing note — if p95 delta persists, capacity planning needs +20% headroom for eu zone because of increased CPU stalls from tail spikes. we should run a full throughput sweep to confirm.

eva: i'll run the microbench pair and post the histograms.

josh: if you can, add quantization variant too (int8 vs int4) — quant sometimes shifts per-token runtime distribution and affects batching interaction with proxy.

eva: ack. will run: 1) direct, 2) via-proxy, 3) via-proxy + int4, 4) direct + int4. expect results in ~20m.

maria: tagging @luca for kernel follow-up and @sre-oncall for retry patterns. thanks. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
